dx_dlbcl_non_gcb.quote: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS, non-germinal-center B-cell phenotype by Hans algorithm

dx_hans_not_abc.note: Lists GEP cell-of-origin as outstanding but never states Hans is only a surrogate for ABC.

dx_not_breast_recurrence.quote: This is not breast carcinoma recurrence: lesional cells are CD20 and PAX5 positive and AE1/AE3 and GATA3 negative

stage_iii.quote: Lugano / Ann Arbor stage III B.

stage_spleen_lymphatic.quote: splenic involvement by multiple FDG-avid nodules is counted as nodal under Lugano

stage_b_symptoms.quote: B symptoms are present: fevers to 38.2-38.4 C for about 5 weeks and drenching night sweats

stage_bulk_definition.quote: which reaches the 7.5 cm threshold used in many protocols but not the 10 cm threshold

mn_stage_iv.quote: If the splenic nodules were judged extranodal the stage would be IV B

mol_del_not_dh.quote: Not double-hit: interphase FISH on 200 nuclei shows no MYC (8q24), BCL2 (18q21) or BCL6 (3q27) rearrangement

mn_da_epoch.quote: This excludes R-CHOP, Pola-R-CHP (the NCCN-preferred, POLARIX-eligible option for IPI 2-5), DA-EPOCH-R

prog_ipi_2.quote: IPI is 2 (stage III and elevated LDH; age 59 and ECOG 1 score 0; no more than one extranodal site)

prog_cns_ipi_2.note: Gives CNS-IPI 1-2 and omits the stage III-IV point, so does not commit to 2.

cns_no_routine_prophylaxis.quote: No CNS-directed prophylaxis is recommended now.

tx_cardioprotection.quote: an ACE inhibitor, ARB or ARNI plus an evidence-based beta-blocker

tx_anthracycline_free_curative.quote: treat with anthracycline-free rituximab-based chemotherapy: R-CEOP-21 for 6 cycles

tx_lower_efficacy_ack.quote: its cure rate is likely lower than the anthracycline-based standard

tx_cardiac_monitoring.quote: troponin and NT-proBNP each cycle, with echocardiogram with GLS before cycle 1, after cycle 3 and at the end of treatment

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: Response assessed by Lugano 2014 criteria with Deauville scoring.

sup_tls_allopurinol.quote: Start allopurinol 300 mg daily two days before cycle 1 (febuxostat if intolerant), with hydration and a BMP

sup_gcsf.quote: Primary G-CSF prophylaxis (pegfilgrastim or biosimilar, or on-body injector) each cycle

sup_anastrozole.quote: Anastrozole: continue to the planned completion in November 2026.

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: HBsAg, anti-HBc and anti-HBs are all nonreactive, so no HBV antiviral prophylaxis is needed for rituximab

miss_cardiac_workup.quote: No troponin, NT-proBNP, ECG, cardiac MRI or ischemia evaluation on record
